mechanical_python_tests.command: .venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_assertion_prompt.py tests/test_llm.py tests/test_evaluation_model.py tests/test_cli.py tests/test_experiment.py tests/test_expanded_replay.py

controlled_comparisons.isolates: larger repair/inspection budget under same contract-v3 and shared corrected diagnostics
additive repair prompt at equal4repair/6inspection resources and same diagnostics

existing_v6_comparison_limit: Historical V6 confirmation differs from all V7 arms by the shared Which-is diagnostic extraction correction; do not attribute that cross-phase difference only to budget, prompt or model variability.

retry_recovery.empty_relative_edit_path: WorkspaceError is a RuntimeError caught by repair. Rejected proposal is persisted with applied:false and feedback. The graph retries while attempt<max_attempts; the last invalid path here happened on attempt2, which exhausted the old budget.
retry_recovery.applied_edits: Whole proposals validate before source writes. Previously applied successful edits remain in the current worktree across retries.
retry_recovery.compiler_failure: verify records compiler output and retry routing exists. The chrono floating-representation remainder compile error arrived after final repair2; extra attempts can receive it, but recovery is not guaranteed.
retry_recovery.proposal_history: All proposals/investigations persist on disk, but only the latest previous_repair is included in the next packet. Explicit source evidence is merged and budgeted, not a complete conversation replay.
retry_recovery.inspection_schedule: Global6 inspections with2per-round can be consumed before repairs1,2,3. Repair4 may have no additional explicit inspection. Automatic current-source context and latest feedback still refresh.
retry_recovery.native_cap_note: Counts two baseline checks, up to one verification per applied repair and final rebase verification; evaluator reproduction adds a separate native preflight. Actual invalid proposals/early stops run fewer.

source_fix_boundary.confirmed_shared_fix: Diagnostic extraction must not infer all GoogleTest Which-is values as actual; root owns this explicit correction for all three V7 arms.
not_fixed_by_budget_alone: Malformed/invalid inspection that ends investigation, context construction failure, unstable or invalid baseline evidence, final-rebase validation rejection and uncertain publication recovery can stop outside the repair retry loop.

Proposal schema requires at least one edit, so an explicit abstention cannot be encoded as empty edits today. This is a separate typed-outcome/schema design issue, not justification to weaken path validation in this experiment.
source_fix_boundary.policy: If a new controller/oracle bug is confirmed, preserve all partial evidence and register a new source version; do not patch one arm mid-comparison or retry only failed cases.

preregistration_quality.primary_selection: Prospectively count native publications without independently confirmed semantic contract regressions; preserve unmodified raw native scores alongside this selection metric.
preregistration_quality.tie_break: All actual Luna investigation+repair calls across24, then descriptive trial latency, then lexicographic arm ID.
preregistration_quality.holdout: No outcomes seen or calls by this audit; freeze winner/source/recipe and held-out execution plan only after72trials and reviews.
preregistration_quality.uncertainty: Twenty-four unique development defects are reused in three arms. Seventy-two trials are not72 independent defects; no guaranteed repair-rate or isolated per-rule causal claim.

prompt_provenance.content: Adds named-operand assertion grounding, rejection of contradicted earlier premises and generic C++ template/numeric-representation checks. Contains no case IDs, repository symbols, expected repair coordinates or fixture-specific values.
prompt_provenance.transport_checks: Synthetic endpoint+Codex checks verify exact selected prompt and hash; explicit model remains unchanged. CLI/config/experiment/replay accept the new key.

scope: Source/prompt/design review and synthetic Python checks only; no prediction of future model success.
